three.js, vendored for Pack B (glossy 3D mascot, Video Styles build spec unit 5), the built-in 3D renderer.
Approved by David: the spike on 2026-11-09 ("vendoring three for the test"); into dev on 2026-11-10 ("just add both as options").

and the tests compare every file with this list; electron/designRender.js allows exactly these paths.

Why each example file: RoomEnvironment (soft reflections), RectAreaLight* (soft area lights), EffectComposer, RenderPass,
ShaderPass, MaskPass, Pass, CopyShader, OutputPass, OutputShader (the post-processing chain), GTAOPass, GTAOShader,
PoissonDenoiseShader, SimplexNoise (ambient occlusion), HorizontalBlurShader, VerticalBlurShader (contact shadows).
